name: Gather Tally
summary: Keeps count of the herbs and ores you pick up while farming and tells you how many you get per hour.
logoPrompt: A small woven basket filled with green leafy herbs and a few chunks of copper and silver ore, with a little wooden tally board leaning against its side

cover.tagline: See what a gathering run brings in.

description: **Gather Tally counts the herbs and ores you loot while you farm, so you see at a glance how well a route pays off.**
- Counts every herb and ore you loot this session, item by item.
- Herbs per hour and ores per hour, measured from the first item you gather.
- A small display that appears with your first herb or ore. Mouse over it to see your most gathered items.
- A short summary in chat whenever you want it.

It starts on its own when you log in. Drag the display where you like it. Type `/gt` (or `/gathertally`) for the session in chat, `/gt reset` to start a new session, `/gt hide` and `/gt show` to hide or show the display.
- Works on Retail. It reads the loot window only, autoloot included, and no combat data.
- Every herb and ore you loot counts, mostly from gathering nodes.
- The per-hour rate appears after 5 minutes, so a single early node does not show a wild number.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Found a bug or have an idea? Leave a comment.
